scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mail/worker" "npm run dev -w @mail/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mail/domain && npm run build -w @mail/web && npm run build -w @mail/worker
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:d1
scripts.db:migrate:control:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply CONTROL_DB --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run db:migrate:control:remote && npm run db:migrate:organization:remote && npm run deploy -w @mail/worker && npm run db:migrate:complete:remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:cloudflare
